items.title: Roche outlays $2.3bn for Hanmi’s non-GLP-1 obesity candidate
items.summary: The licensing deal marks a diversification of Roche’s obesity pipeline as it seeks entry into the lucrative market.

items.title: Reaching maturity: A roadmap for Quality Excellence amid regulatory transformation
items.summary: A convergence of regulations across life sciences has shifted quality management from a burden into an imperative for excellence.

items.title: CKD market expected to reach $10.9bn across the 7MM by 2035
items.summary: The chronic kidney disease (CKD) market is poised to grow at a CAGR of 9.8% from $4.3bn in 2025 to $10.9bn in 2035 across the 7MM.

items.title: Analysts praise intismeran’s landmark Phase III win, look to further data
items.summary: Analysts now turn to intismeran’s upcoming Phase II RCC readout, which they say could signal the drug’s wider potential across solid tumours.

items.title: A strategic shift for gene therapies: manufacturing and market size take centre stage
items.summary: A desire for sustainable growth is pushing gene therapy biotechs to be strategic about manufacturing and pipelines.
